title: memory
description: A memory-fragment: a typed, provenanced EAVT positing event the conductor durably knows. Per continuous-learning's memoryBoundary, memory is a LOCAL FRAGMENT that is a typed resource carrying provenance -- it is an eavt-row (entity e=token, attribute a=claim, value v, time t) plus required `evidence` (provenance) and a `placement` (the slug of the $thing where this memory belongs / will be needed). Being present in a spacesuit is NOT memory (noContextPresenceAsDurableLearning); only a posited memory row is.

t.description: logical/ISO time of the positing event

placement.description: slug of the $thing where this memory belongs
